index_guard.rule: index entries of another params_file_sha256 are not used (missing / held, not substituted)

meta.stage: S4 branch A (chrono_build_plan.md S4): V7 six modes (projection + ERA), beta sensitivity, leg damping sensitivity, optional rod-side k_v
meta.judgement: dyn final ruling: pass (dynamics_model.md rev. 19, 5.8; independent check 06_analysis/00_dynamics/s4_check.json); this file applies that judgement specification to the stored runs

era.channels: q (surge, sway, heave, roll, pitch, yaw) of the reference point, weighted by sqrt(diag M) for the SVD
era.mode_selection: largest start amplitude in eta_i within f_ref +-15 % (nominal Phi as the label, also for beta)

meta.mode_assignment_runner_up_rule: information (dynamics_model.md 5.13.8 (1)): runner-up / judged predicted amplitude >= 0.8 -> the judged row records runner_up and runner_up_amplitude_ratio; zeta of that mode is read with the projection leakage
